conventions: Blanks carry -1; token counters are 0..N-1. A carries the cyclic sheet and B controls the local blank/zero-token swap. The two walkers stay at their recorded or coherently superposed sites during the circuit. Moving A then carries its sheet with it.
scope: Integer coherent signed counts and a reversible physical-site token register; no observation of courier position or stored counter. One nearest-neighbour move per round, plus local emission and absorption. A programmable cyclic counter, message alphabet, idle controls and gain table per ring are supplied. This checks macro-operation equivalence without identifying physical durations or supplying a uniform gate alphabet.

moving_packets.witness: A, B move with unit masses and opposite forces, relative acceleration -2 kappa sin(A-B). Each compact classical ensemble assigns equal normalized mass to the endpoints of four independent initial position and velocity intervals. The analytic enclosures cover their entire Cartesian product. The binary read has total variation one at positive coupling. A common local prediction for its two probabilities then has worst-case error at least 1/2.
moving_packets.clock: Elapsed time is the signed classical flow parameter. A hypothetical local process with physical speed v has backward radius v*abs(elapsed). Distances are physical torus lengths. No identification with the parked courier's N rounds or a microscopic tick duration is assumed.
moving_packets.scope: Point trajectories and finite classical ensembles. Quantum packet propagation and finite walk approximation are separate questions.
